parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Additionally, the two methods resolve structurally different entity types (`Artist` vs `Master`), so the structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects coincidental mock-method shape rather than a genuine generic-parameterization opportunity. Consolidating these into a shared generic test helper would couple two independent test packages around domain-specific mock behaviour.
